image_description: A side-profile view of a large American Bison standing in a grassy enclosure with green trees and a wire fence in the background. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump, transitioning to smoother, darker fur on the hindquarters. It features a large head with short curved horns, a beard, and sturdy legs partially obscured by tall grass.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct fringe of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the 'beard' description.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, consistent with the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blended into the thick fur of the head/neck junction.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits significant mass and height at the shoulders, creating the characteristic sloping back profile of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture of the fur on the front half of the body is visibly coarse and shaggy, creating a clear hump shape.
There is a visible textural transition where the fur on the rear flank and legs becomes shorter and smoother compared to the shoulder area.

While the legs are visible, the feet are completely obscured by the tall green grass in the foreground, making it impossible to verify the presence or shape of cloven hooves.
The tail is visible hanging down behind the hind legs, appearing short with a darker, bushier end.
